reaction_description: Benzaldehyde and malononitrile were combined with an N-doped carbon heterogeneous basic catalyst in acetonitrile and heated.
raw_text: Benzaldehyde (5.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and malononitrile (5.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) were combined with an N-doped carbon heterogeneous basic catalyst in acetonitrile. The suspension was heated at 50 C for 24 h in a 25 mL round-bottom flask. The 2-benzylidenemalononitrile product was obtained in 85% yield.
